text: {"summary":"The prod cluster scores 52 on NSA and 55 on MITRE in kubescape. Trivy PSS passed all 17 controls. The main risk is over-broad RBAC: a developers group bound to cluster-admin, and a CI service account with a wildcard ClusterRole that can also read secrets. No critical or high image CVEs were reported; 4 MEDIUM vulnerabilities exist. Node and control-plane checks were not performed.","targets":["prod"],"frameworks":[{"name":"NSA","passed":10,"failed":11,"skipped":5,"score":52.0},{"name":"MITRE","passed":9,"failed":9,"skipped":5,"score":55.0},{"name":"Trivy PSS","passed":17,"failed":0,"skipped":0,"score":null}],"findings":[{"severity":"HIGH","title":"CI service account bound to wildcard ClusterRole with secrets access and exec","resource":"ClusterRole/ci-wildcard, ClusterRoleBinding/ci-bot-wild (ServiceAccount ci/ci-bot)","controls":["C-0035","C-0015","C-0002","KSV-0041"],"evidence":"Kubescape flags ci-wildcard under C-0035, C-0015 and C-0002, Trivy flags it under KSV-0041 (Manage secrets), and rbac_and_argo shows it bound to ServiceAccount ci/ci-bot.","fix":"Replace wildcards with a least-privilege Role scoped to the CI namespace: `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding ci-bot-wild` then create a namespaced Role/RoleBinding listing only the required verbs and resources (no secrets get/list, no pods/exec)."},{"severity":"HIGH","title":"Developers group bound to cluster-admin","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding/dev-team-admin (Group developers)","controls":["C-0035"],"evidence":"rbac_and_argo shows dev-team-admin binding role cluster-admin to Group developers, and kubescape lists it as an example for C-0035; this is not a platform default.","fix":"kubectl delete clusterrolebinding dev-team-admin  # then bind the group to the built-in 'edit' or 'view' ClusterRole via namespaced RoleBindings"},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Built-in admin and edit ClusterRoles can manage secrets","resource":"ClusterRole/admin, ClusterRole/edit","controls":["KSV-0041","C-0015"],"evidence":"Trivy KSV-0041 reports 3 resources including ClusterRole/admin and ClusterRole/edit; these look like Kubernetes default roles, so treat as expected unless they have been modified.","fix":"Restrict who is bound to admin/edit; no change to the default roles is needed unless they were customized (check with `kubectl get clusterrole edit -o yaml`)."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Medium-severity vulnerabilities in workloads","resource":"prod cluster images","controls":[],"evidence":"Trivy k8s reports 4 MEDIUM vulnerabilities and no critical or high ones; the digest gives no package or fixed-version details.","fix":"Review with `trivy k8s --severity MEDIUM --report all` and upgrade to the fixed versions it lists."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Expected platform cluster-admin bindings","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin (Group system:masters), ClusterRoleBinding/helm-kube-system-traefik (ServiceAccount kube-system/helm-traefik)","controls":["C-0035"],"evidence":"rbac_and_argo lists these cluster-admin bindings; the system:masters one is a Kubernetes default and the kube-system helm-traefik one looks like a k3s-managed add-on, so both are likely expected.","fix":"No action required; keep system:masters membership restricted and confirm the traefik helm job is still needed."}],"not_checked":[{"item":"node and control-plane CIS checks","reason":"need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"},{"item":"git history","reason":"secrets removed from history are not scanned"},{"item":"Skipped kubescape controls (5 in NSA, 5 in MITRE)","reason":"the digest reports them as skipped without saying why"},{"item":"Vulnerability details for the 4 MEDIUM findings","reason":"the digest gives only counts, not packages, images or fixed versions"}]}
